integrity: Exact proof by rank-order independence and conditional future records; rational verification compares independent finite enumeration with the analytic kernel. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature audit.
scientific_limitations: Strict covariance negativity is proved for iid product sampling on the unit square with atomless nondegenerate marginals and fixed origin; the harmonic closed form and its asymptotics specialize to uniform coordinates. No claim for dependent coordinates, varying references, or higher dimensions.
title: Universal negative covariance of planar Pareto-front size and dominated hypervolume
